description:
Stay on top of your deliveries and manage your logistics quickly - right from your conversation. The DHL app for ChatGPT makes it simple to check shipment status and locate nearby DHL services without switching apps or searching multiple websites.

Track shipments instantly
Enter a tracking number and get up-to-date delivery status.

Find DHL locations near you
Discover nearby DHL ServicePoints, drop-off locations, and parcel shops with relevant details such as address and availability.

Save time
No need to visit separate tracking pages or search for locations manually.
Convenient 
Manage shipments while you’re already using ChatGPT for other tasks.
Up-to-date information
Receive straightforward, easy-to-understand updates and directions.

Whether you’re expecting an important delivery or looking for the closest drop-off point, the DHL app helps you get essential logistics information quickly and efficiently.
